summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend testing of new features: project-based access control, project templates (general/event/camp), per-project currency, comprehensive Budget module (view/CRUD/permission), and Project Settings dialog. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering access control (owner sees 4 projects incl 'Operasyon (Gizli)'; member mert does NOT; member gets 403 on restricted /tasks and /budget), budget seeded (11 items on festival, TRY, can_edit=true, policy=members), budget CRUD flow with GET-after-write persistence, admin-only policy (Ürün Geliştirme returns can_edit=false to member, POST returns 403; owner can POST 200), templates exposed in bootstrap, event & camp project creation produce template-specific statuses+categories+currency, project PATCH by owner updates members/currency/policy, and non-privileged member PATCH silently strips priv-only fields. Regressions (dashboard status_distribution list shape, search) still green. Frontend (Playwright, public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): Owner sees 4 sidebar projects incl Operasyon; Member (mert) sees only 3, Operasyon hidden from bootstrap+UI. Owner opens project-settings-dialog on Festival with settings-currency-select, settings-policy-select, 4 settings-member-* toggles and settings-save-btn. Budget view for Festival renders budget-view with ₺ summary cards, planned-vs-actual bar chart, category summary, and item tables; add-budget-btn opens budget-dialog with all documented testids; created TEST_ui_budget/TEST_delete_me items appear then were deleted successfully. add-project-btn opens create-project-dialog with project-template-select (Etkinlik/Yarış selectable) + project-currency-select. Member on Ürün Geliştirme sees NO settings-btn, NO add-budget-btn, and 'Yalnızca görüntüleme' text (policy=admins). Member on Festival (policy=members) sees add-budget-btn. All requested testids present and functional.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking project-save-btn with a filled name-input, event template and USD currency selections, dialog closed but new project did not appear in sidebar within 2s. Possible race condition — backend endpoint works fine via API (verified in pytest). May need to await mutation + invalidate ['bootstrap'] cache before closing dialog, or add a success toast + loading state.

integration_issues.issue: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning (thrown by Recharts on layout resize) is being escalated by react-scripts to a full-page 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay that intercepts all clicks in the preview environment. Non-fatal but visually alarming and BLOCKS interactions (had to dismiss overlay to click project-settings-btn during automation). Consider silencing this specific error with a window.addEventListener('error', ...) guard or upgrading to CRA-style overlay hide for benign RO warnings.

action_items: MEDIUM: Investigate why creating a project via the sidebar create-project-dialog (project-save-btn) does not surface the new project in the sidebar list — API works, so this is a cache-invalidation / mutation race in the UI. Ensure onSuccess awaits queryClient.invalidateQueries(['bootstrap']) before closing the dialog.

MEDIUM: Silence Recharts' ResizeObserver-loop warning to prevent the react-scripts dev error overlay from blocking user interactions in the preview environment (window.addEventListener('error', e => { if (e.message.includes('ResizeObserver')) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); })).
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py has grown to ~785 lines with budget endpoints added — strongly recommend splitting into per-resource routers (auth/projects/tasks/ideas/budget) for maintainability.
Budget delete endpoint (DELETE /api/budget/{item_id}) returns {ok: true} even when item does not exist (line 761-762). Consider returning 404 for missing items to give the UI accurate feedback.

In update_project (routes.py:257), when non-privileged users PATCH with priv-only fields (members/budget_policy) the fields are silently dropped. Consider returning 403 or at least a warning header so the UI can surface it — otherwise a member can appear to 'save' settings that were actually ignored.

can_access_project falls through org-wide when is_privileged is true — that's fine, but there's no explicit check that the requesting user's org_id matches the project's org_id (only members check considers user_id). If multi-tenant support expands, admins from other orgs could see cross-org projects. Add org_id equality guard.

Prior iteration items still open: login lockout resets window on every failure (line 141-147); WebSocket auth uses get_ws_user but that helper is not shown to reject invalid tokens; invite_member still uses shared DEMO_PASSWORD.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all documented testids/flows verified; only create-project persistence bug + dev overlay observed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_2.json + /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py cover new access control + budget + templates features. All backend endpoints healthy. Two frontend follow-ups: (1) create-project via sidebar UI needs cache invalidation fix, (2) ResizeObserver dev overlay from Recharts blocks clicks in preview — needs global suppression. Test data uses TEST_ prefix. Bootstrap now returns 'templates' dict {general/event/camp: {label, icon}}. Access control uses per-project 'members' list + created_by; owners/admins see all.
rca of the issue: 1) Create-project UI: no confirmed cause — hypothesis is React Query cache not refetched after mutation because dialog closes before ['bootstrap'] invalidation resolves. 2) ResizeObserver overlay: harmless Recharts warning being upgraded to error by react-scripts dev overlay; standard fix is to swallow the event listener before it bubbles.
